scenarios: getStaleGRNs_returnsRecentUnmatchedGRNs - Verifies that GRNs with recent receivedDate (today) that are unmatched are now returned (main fix scenario)
getStaleGRNs_returnsAllUnmatchedGRNsRegardlessOfAge - Verifies that all unmatched GRNs are returned regardless of their age (recent to old)
getStaleGRNs_excludesMatchedGRNs - Verifies that GRNs matched with PurchaseInvoice are correctly excluded
getStaleGRNs_excludesDraftGRNs - Verifies that GRNs with DRAFT status are not returned
getStaleGRNs_returnsEmptyListWhenAllGRNsMatched - Edge case: empty result when reconciliation is complete
getStaleGRNs_countConsistencyWithRepositoryCount - Verifies consistency between findStaleGRNs and countUnmatchedGRNs
fixDescription: Removed 'AND g.receivedDate < :threshold' from findStaleGRNs query in GoodsReceiptRepository.java to return ALL unmatched GRNs instead of only GRNs older than X days
note: Test file needs to be manually created in the test directory as edit tool cannot create new files
